# 10 Refunds

R-01 Refunds go back to the original payment method.
R-02 A refund reverses the paid state (FACT-SENTINEL-REFUND-REVERSES).
R-03 A reversed booking returns its room to the pool.
R-04 Partial refunds are recorded as adjustments.
R-05 Adjustments never change the booking total.
R-06 Refund failures are retried three times.
R-07 A failed refund is shown to staff.
R-08 Staff can retry a failed refund once.
R-09 Refund history is part of the booking history.
R-10 Refund reports use the recorded history.
